description: Compiled US fiscal target spec metadata, one target per (family, target_role) plus four IRS SOI rows carrying an AGI band or an EITC child-count filter, from compile_us_fiscal_target_registry over the Chronicle feed PolicyEngine/microcosm#955 pins. Public aggregate target metadata; no microdata. ledger_filter_key_census covers every compiled target, not only the sampled rows. Regenerate with experiments/us-labelled-filter-support/census_compiled_ledger_filters.py. Captured at 369dedf1f, BEFORE this branch merged origin/main: that merge brought in ledger_targets._constraint_bound_filters, which stamps a fact's numeric universe constraints as ledger_filter_<variable>_{lower,upper}_bound, so a compile at the current head carries restated keys this census does not list (us:statutes/26/62#adjusted_gross_income_{lower,upper}_bound on 1080/1074 targets, us.tax.earned_income_credit_qualifying_children_lower_bound on 1137, and age_{lower,upper}_bound on 939/886 census_population targets). The rows here therefore pin the pre-merge compile; test_pinned_chronicle_feed_state_surface_compiles_no_unsupported_filters is the arm that exercises the restated keys against the live feed.
